description: Fetch the full Recall Canary record for a single U.S. federal recall, given the agency and slug returned by search_recalls. Includes the hazard description, the affected product list with lot codes and UPCs, the recommended consumer action, distribution, the agency source link, and the firm slug (`firm.slug`, with `firm.page_url` when the firm has a page) for search_recalls' `firm` filter. Also resolves preliminary agency press releases: an orphan, or a linked one that kept its own URL (its recalls in `linked_recalls`). Read-only.

agency.description: Lowercase agency segment from the record URL. Part of the lookup key, not decoration: a correct slug under the wrong agency is a miss.

slug.description: The record slug from its URL, e.g. "acme-foods-peanut-butter". The 26-character ULID id is also accepted and resolves to what its URL shows (for a matched press release, often its recall).

name: get_recall

outputSchema.description: One record. `record_type` says which kind: a canonical `recall` (products, timeline, dates, related) or a `preliminary` agency press release (linked_recalls, company and agency dates).

agency.description: Known values: FDA, FDA_IRES, FSIS, CPSC, NHTSA, ADMIN.

ai_generated.description: Provenance: true where the field holds model-written text. Over-attributes on purpose.

category.description: True only for a press release's model-classified category.
Known values: FOOD, DRUG, BIOLOGIC, DEVICE, COSMETIC, CONSUMER_PRODUCT, VEHICLE, AUTO_EQUIPMENT.

company_product_list.description: The company's own list of the affected products, when the agency notice points to it instead of naming them. A product missing from `identification` may still be recalled: check this list.

consumer_action.description: The "What to do" text. Null on a withdrawn alert.

content_changed_at.description: When the published content last changed.

critical_flags.description: NHTSA-only in practice. An absent key means the agency did not state the flag. null for a withdrawn (RETRACTED) record.

announced_at.description: Deprecated since api 2.7.0: for FDA the firm's start of the recall (began_at), never a public announcement.

began_at.description: Since api 2.7.0. The recall's own start: FDA's Date Initiated by Firm; null for FSIS, CPSC and NHTSA.

fda_posted_at.description: Since api 2.7.0. FDA only: when FDA first posted the recall to its Enforcement Report.

listed_at_basis.description: What listed_at is: company_announced, fda_posted, fda_classified, listed, unconfirmed, none, agency_announced or nhtsa_reported.

description.description: Full agency description. FSIS: sanitized HTML; others: plain text. Sanitize or escape before display.

countries_all.description: The agency's structured manufacturing-country list (CPSC only), each country once; [] for FDA, FSIS and NHTSA.

country.description: CPSC: the first manufacturing country it lists. FDA: the firm's address country.

page_url.description: /firm/<slug> page, only when that page is indexable.

slug.description: The firm filter value (`firm=` on search_recalls).

html_url.description: Absolute URL of the human-readable page.

identification.description: Page-derived identification: the products and codes the record names. Not a completeness guarantee; `partial` says when the list is incomplete, including when this response cut `products` to 25 (`mcp_truncated.identification_products`).

ai_generated.description: True when the product list came from a model-written identifier line.

hidden.description: Values the stored cell left out (a capped list).

late.description: Since api 2.7.0. Null unless the recall is late: it began more than 184 days before listed_at, or it ended on or before the date its listed_at_basis names.

retroactive.description: The agency's own text says the recall was reported retroactively.

agency.description: Known values: FDA, FDA_IRES, FSIS, CPSC, NHTSA, ADMIN.

ai_generated.description: Since api 2.7.0. Which fields of this ref the enrichment pipeline wrote.

title.description: True when title is the stored display_title (enrichment text).

reason.description: Why this record is listed here, plain text.

title.description: Since api 2.7.0: the title the record's card shows (its judged display_title, model-written when ai_generated.title is true); the cleaned agency title for a record without one.

listed_at.description: Since api 2.6.0. The date the listing shows and sorts by; equals this record's search_recalls row. A recall's listing date is in dates.listed_at.

mcp_truncated.description: Present only when a long list was cut to 25 for this response.

notes.description: Caveats for this record, including the aggregator-lag and not-a-clearance statement.

items.description: A linked agency press release, as a link only.

canary_url.description: Usually the recall's own url (it took the press release's).

published_at.description: Deprecated: the stored pub_date. Read company_announced_at / agency_published_at.

product_count.description: The true event scope, which may exceed products.length.

items.description: One affected product. Lot codes and UPCs: one code per element, every code held; `*_omitted` counts the codes the agency notice lists beyond them.

catalog_numbers.description: Since api 2.6.0. The catalog, REF or part numbers the agency notice lists, one per element.

gtin.description: Since api 2.6.0. The GS1-valid codes of `upc` (a GTIN, or a UDI-DI on a device), without the product's own lots, serials and catalog numbers.

serial_numbers.description: Since api 2.6.0. The serial numbers the agency notice lists, one per element.

serial_numbers_omitted.description: Since api 2.6.0. How many more serial numbers the notice lists than `serial_numbers`, where a stored list was cut.

products_truncated.description: True when `product_count` exceeds the length of `products`

reason.description: The agency's own stated reason, not model-written.

agency.description: Known values: FDA, FDA_IRES, FSIS, CPSC, NHTSA, ADMIN.

events.description: Stored relations of this record, at most 20. Absent (not empty) while RELATIONS_DISPLAY is off.

risk.description: The agency rating as the page shows it (for example "High risk" for an FDA Class I recall). Null where the page shows no risk line.

explained_at.description: Absolute URL of the page that explains the rating.

snapshot_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC response-generation time, second precision. First key on purpose.

source_recall_id.description: Agency key; a CPSC one can be stale.

story_lead_id.description: Set on a later record of a recall story; the lead it belongs to.

timeline.description: Dated steps of the record, in date order. Each step names who acted on that date. FDA labels: Company began the recall, Announced by the company, Added to FDA's Enforcement Report, Classified by FDA, In FDA's weekly enforcement report; then Listed on Recall Canary, Summary updated, Recall ended, Archived.
